name: commit-with-claude
description: Consistent, style-locked commit messages from the Claude Code you are already signed in to.

enumDescriptions: Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, bullet body
Conventional Commits with a required scope
Angular convention: strict types, prose body explaining why
Gitmoji: emoji prefix, subject, bullet body
Classic 50/72: capitalised subject, prose body, no type prefix
One-liner: a single subject line, no body
commitWithClaude.style.description: Commit message style. Every generated message follows this style exactly. Set it in workspace settings to enforce a convention for one repository.

commitWithClaude.model.markdownDescription: Model to use. Leave empty for **Default**, which uses whatever model Claude Code is currently set to. Otherwise a model id from Claude Code's picker, e.g. `claude-sonnet-5-5`.

commitWithClaude.effort.description: Effort level passed to Claude Code. Low is fast and was indistinguishable in quality for commit messages in testing.

enumDescriptions: Add a body only when the subject alone does not explain the change
commitWithClaude.bodyMode.description: When to include a commit body below the subject line.

commitWithClaude.language.description: Language the commit message is written in.

commitWithClaude.extraInstructions.description: Additional rules appended to the prompt, e.g. 'Reference the Jira key from the branch name in the footer'.

commitWithClaude.recentCommitExamples.description: How many recent commit subjects from the repository to show the model as style examples. 0 disables.

commitWithClaude.ignoreGlobs.markdownDescription: Extra glob patterns whose diffs are replaced by a one-line summary. Lockfiles, minified bundles, source maps and snapshots are already excluded, as are files marked `linguist-generated` or `-diff` in `.gitattributes`.

commitWithClaude.maxFileDiffChars.description: Per-file diff size limit in characters. Larger diffs are truncated with a marker.

commitWithClaude.maxTotalDiffChars.description: Total diff size limit in characters. Files beyond the limit are summarised instead of included.

commitWithClaude.claudePath.description: Path to the claude executable. Leave empty to auto-detect.

commitWithClaude.timeoutSeconds.description: Give up waiting for Claude after this many seconds.

commitWithClaude.debug.description: Write prompts and raw responses to the Commit with Claude output channel.
